limits_and_controls.affiliated_controls: fame controls and affiliation twins; exact enumeration, both tails
limits_and_controls.planted_designs: every triple of unaffiliated users (BH over 3 per test; group test by exact enumeration) and each user alone

reference_effect.what: direct 1-10 grading, famous-AI group minus general population, Transluce main Claude run

limits_and_controls.temporal_extra: exchange by session and leading-identity contrast on the registered temporal check's 10,000 shuffles

paid_part.m_rule: B = min($3.00 - analysis spend after the pilot, $5.00 - workflow spend after the pilot). c_s = the pilot's mean cost per call for subject s, from returned usage. Over the kept subjects, m = floor(B / (64 * sum c_s)) - 10, capped at 32. If m < 12, drop the subject with the largest c_s and recompute; repeat until m >= 12 or no subject is left. A dropped subject is reported from stored data only.

pilot.use: pricing only; pilot grades never enter a test

paid_part.stop_rule: Personas are sampled in order (10 originals, then the decoys in DECOY_ORDER[:m]), one persona at a time across the kept subjects in SUBJECTS order. The session reserves min(budget after the pilot, 1.25 x planned cost) in the workflow's shared ledger. Before a persona starts for a subject, the driver requires analysis spend + 64 * 1.25 * max(pilot c_s, running c_s) <= that reservation (and the same against the $5.00 workflow cap). Otherwise that persona and every later one is recorded as not sampled for that subject. Every request also passes the per-request cap.
